maria: Hey team — scheduling Dedicated + Private rollout for ZetaBank. Customer wants a reserved GPU pool plus on-prem connector. Proposed change window: 2026-03-12 23:00 - 00:30 UTC. Target model pinned: redwood-reasoner-2.3-quant (sha: abc123). Need approvals for change window, KMS, and capacity reservation.

ian_ops: Oncall — that window overlaps nightly backups in eu-west-1. Can we move earlier to 22:00? Risk: tail latency during prefix warmup.

sam_eng: We can mitigate. Plan to pre-warm KV cache + do autoscaler ramp earlier. If customer insists on 23:00 we can still meet SLA with pre-warm and a 2-step canary.

julia_cs: CS checked — customer prefers after their close-of-day (their local 18:00), 23:00 UTC is fine. They want a short readout and explicit rollback criteria.

anne_legal: Legal okay with the rollout provided KMS config is supplied and we confirm no sensitive data exfil path. Please attach KMS key id.

leo_infra: Infra: recommend pinning instance family to p4d for Dedicated pool to hit P99 targets. I can reserve capacity after +1s. Also need to know expected QPS and token rates.

maria: Rollout notes (summary):
```
- Customer: ZetaBank (private/private-network)
- Models: redwood-reasoner-2.3-quant (pinned)
- Change window: 2026-03-12T23:00:00Z -> 2026-03-13T00:30:00Z
- Canary policy: 1% -> 10% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (20m)
- Pre-warm: run prefix warmers + restore KV caches 30m prior
- Fallback: auto-route to redwood-reasoner-2.2 (cpu-quant) if node pool unhealthy
- Rollback triggers: error rate increase > 2% OR median latency > 700ms for 10m
- Alerting: send to #eng-oncall and PagerDuty (team: infra)
```

ian_ops: Rollback triggers look good. Add a temporary latency SLO suppression rule for noisy warmup so we don't page for expected spikes during first 20m. Also add a manual escape hatch to route traffic to hosted tier.

sam_eng: Ops/Infra — can we get final +1s? I'll be the primary eng responder for the first hour.

leo_infra: +1 (reserving p4d capacity) — ticket INC-5542 opened

ian_ops: +1 (will monitor, PD response team on standby)

julia_cs: +1 (customer notified and confirmed). Customer oncall contacts: alice@zetabank, bob@zetabank

anne_legal: +1 KMS key id: projects/zetabank/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/zk-01

maria: Thanks — scheduling then. @deploy-bot please schedule and post the runbook link to this thread.

sam_eng: I'll add a short troubleshooting checklist to the runbook (how to validate KV cache warm, how to force fallback, debug headers).

maria: I'll draft the post-deploy readout template and put it in the runbook. Please add any metrics you want in the readout. :thumbsup:

julia_cs: Customer acked the scheduled window and will standby during the first 30m for verification. :party_parrot:
